questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Pakistan?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: The capital of Pakistan is Islamabad, but before 1960, it was Karachi, which is now the country's largest city.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Islamabad?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Pakistan is Islamabad.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Pakistan?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Pakistan on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography and climate” part of the Pakistan article.

questions.proof: Apart from the 1,046 km (650 mi) Arabian Sea coastline, Pakistan's land borders total 6,774 km (4,209 mi)—2,430 km (1,510 mi) with Afghanistan to the northwest, 523 km (325 mi) with China to the northeast, 2,912 km (1,809 mi) with India to the south and east, and 909 km (565 mi) with Iran to the southwest.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Pakistan on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Pakistan on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Pakistan about 881,913 square kilometres; Cambodia about 181,035 square kilometres; United Arab Emirates about 83,600 square kilometres; Latvia about 64,594 square kilometres.
